title: Intrinsic bounded constructible objects are comparison images
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $T$ a Noetherian scheme. In the ordinary derived categories of fixed-coefficient module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories; def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], a pro-etale complex $K$ is bounded and every cohomology sheaf [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves] is constructible on a global finite partition [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf] if and only if there is a bounded constructible etale complex $H$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] and an isomorphism $\nu_T^*H\cong K$, where $\nu_T^*$ is the comparison pullback [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism].

proof.text: Use the finite-model comparison lemmas to identify fixed-module constructibility with the existing finite-constant locally constructible pro-etale predicate, including the empty-scheme case. Translate the recorded etale module constructibility predicate to the source constructible-sheaf predicate and translate boundedness between the explicit integer interval and the canonical bounded t-structure.

Apply the existing bounded constructible comparison theorem to each pro-etale cohomology sheaf, obtain an etale origin for the bounded complex, and use exact comparison homology isomorphisms to prove the converse and transport constructibility.

theorem exceptionalTransport_constructible_comparison
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] :
    (fun K ↦ _root_.DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.bounded K ∧
      ∀ i : ℤ, Scheme.IsConstructibleProEtaleFixedModuleSheaf T A
        ((_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj K)) =
    (Etale.DerivedCategory.isBoundedConstructible A T).map
      (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).mapDerivedCategory
